name: What is the typical lifespan of a metal roof compared to other roofing materials?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of a metal roof compared to other roofing materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs are known for their exceptional durability and longevity, often lasting 40-70 years or even longer, depending on the material and maintenance. This significantly exceeds the typical lifespan of traditional asphalt shingle roofs, which usually last 15-30 years. While the initial investment might be higher, the extended lifespan of a metal roof means fewer replacements over time, offering a practical tradeoff that often results in long-term cost savings. Discounted Roofing Co. offers metal roofing options designed for maximum durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs last 40-70+ years, far exceeding asphalt shingles (15-30 years). This longevity offers a practical tradeoff for higher initial cost, leading to long-term savings.
